app.name: PureCut
app.description: Local timeline video editing with your PureDesktop agent.

tools.name: fn_inspectCutProject
tools.description: Inspect the open PureCut project in one call: reads context, hash, playhead, fonts, objectMasks, and JSX, parses scenes, runs structural checks, checks tracking status, and summarizes transcript availability.

sceneId.description: Optional scene id to check; defaults to the active scene.

checkAllScenes.description: Check every scene in the JSX instead of only the active scene (default false).

includeSource.description: Include full JSX source (default true; false for compact summary).

includeTranscriptSummary.description: Include saved transcript readiness, word count, and filler count (default true).

tools.name: fn_analyzeCutSpeech
tools.description: Read and analyze the saved transcript across pages without uploading audio. Returns fresh baseHash, duration, per-speaker stats, filler summary, exact {start, end} phrase matches, and optional timestamped words.

queries.description: Exact phrases to locate with edited-timeline {start, end} ranges.

includeWords.description: Include timestamped words (default false with queries, true otherwise).

maxWords.description: Max returned words (default 500; scans up to 5000).

tools.name: fn_proposeSpeechWorkflow
tools.description: Prepare a speech edit proposal with a fresh baseHash: delete ranges, create a highlight scene, clean up fillers, shorten silences, or generate captions from the saved transcript. Presents for user review; never mutates directly.

title.description: Optional highlight scene name describing the passage.

includeRepetitions.description: For fillers: include repeated-word suggestions (default false).

minimumSeconds.description: For pauses: min silence seconds to shorten (default 1.5).

retainSeconds.description: For pauses: retained pause seconds (default 0.3, < minimumSeconds).

openPanelIfNoTranscript.description: Open transcript setup panel if no transcript exists (default true).

tools.name: fn_trackOrInspectObjectMask
tools.description: Inspect existing tracked object masks and tracking status, or request the person to track a subject in a video clip (cutout, blur, pixelate, behind). Reuses existing masks, avoids duplicate requests, and refuses in held copies.

action.description: "inspect" (default) lists masks/status; "request" opens the Object mask tool.

clip.description: Video clip "index.tsx:<id>" to filter or target (required for request).

at.description: Optional suggested frame point (0-1 from top-left).

time.description: Optional timeline second within the clip.

label.description: Short subject label shown to the user (e.g. "his face").

forceNew.description: Allow new tracking even when the clip already has a mask (default false).

tools.name: getCutContext
tools.description: Read the open timeline project JSX, revision hash, playhead, fonts, objectMasks (masks the user tracked, each with its .mask path, footage, sourceIn and the clip ids playing that footage) and pendingTrack (a trackCutObject request still waiting for the person). Read before edits.

tools.name: proposeCutEdits
tools.description: Propose scoped changes to directly authored elements for user review. Apply uses normal editor undo as one step and preserves prior history. Prefer for timing, placement, appearance and text edits. Read getCutContext first; use index.tsx:<stable element id> targets. Does not edit video by transcript or change asset sources. Locked or loop-generated targets are rejected.

text.description: The words a text element says, replacing its current words. Not for styling: to recolour a text use props.fill.

fill.description: Hex colour such as #DF2626. On a text or rect this is the colour it is seen in: it recolours the element's topmost visible solid paint (or its own fill when it has none). Never put a colour in `text`; `text` is only what the element says.

value.description: An <effect>'s amount: blur radius or pixelate block size in px (privacy strength), hueRotate degrees, 0-1 otherwise.

blur.description: On a <mask>: its feather in px. On a node: its own blur in px.

tools.name: proposeCutSource
tools.description: Propose edited project JSX for the user to review and apply. Read getCutContext first and use its baseHash. Does not save until the user applies the proposal. Preserve unrelated content and stable ids. Prefer this over direct replacement. For clip paths, object masks, privacy blur and text behind a subject see agents.md: reuse existing .mask files only (getCutContext objectMasks); the user's Object mask tool makes them, and when none exists ask the user to track the subject with it.

tools.name: exportCut
tools.description: Render a scene from the open PureCut project to an MP4 video file in the project renders folder using a scene id from getCutContext. Only call when explicitly requested by the user; export does not prove transcript accuracy or speech-cut quality (review playback for those). Refuses when held inside a page.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureCut's extended specialist tools (9 tools across editing, inspection, speech, tracking) and composite functions (4 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "editing", "inspection", "speech", "tracking").

category.description: Optional category filter (editing, inspection, speech, tracking, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureCut's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: editing, inspection, speech, tracking). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureCut's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: editing, inspection, speech, tracking). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
